input.command:
echo "== big dirs =="; du -sh ~/Library/Containers/com.docker.docker ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData ~/Library/Developer/CoreSimulator ~/Library/Caches ~/Library/Application\ Support/MobileSync/Backup ~/Library/Application\ Support ~/Library/Containers ~/Library/Group\ Containers ~/.cache ~/.npm ~/.cargo ~/go ~/Library/pnpm ~/.bun 2>/dev/null | sort -h
echo; echo "-- top-level home --"; du -sh ~/* ~/.[!.]* 2>/dev/null | sort -h | tail -25
echo; echo "-- node_modules --"; find ~ -name node_modules -type d -prune -not -path "*/Library/*" 2>/dev/null | wc -l; find ~ -name node_modules -type d -prune -not -path "*/Library/*" 2>/dev/null | xargs du -sh 2>/dev/null | sort -h | tail -8
echo; echo "-- .git dirs (repos) --"; find ~ -maxdepth 4 -name .git -type d -not -path "*/Library/*" -not -path "*/node_modules/*" 2>/dev/null | wc -l
input.description: Measure large directories and regenerable caches in home
